instruction: William and I have been carpooling to work this month. They have requested money for it on venmo. Accept it.
notes: William's identity is resolved via the phone contact book (query "William"; a coworker since they carpool to work), yielding his email. The matching pending Venmo payment request is found with venmo.show_received_payment_requests (query "carpool", filtered by sender email) and approved with venmo.approve_payment_request. The goal requires exactly that request to be approved (not denied, no new/deleted requests), then supervisor.complete_task with no answer. If the Venmo balance were insufficient, the optional payment_card_id of approve_payment_request (from venmo.show_payment_cards) could be supplied; this is not modeled. Tokens are tied to their app via token-for; passwords come from supervisor.show_account_passwords.
